objective: Get me $1,500 of settled cash in the next 14 days. I have no money to put in, so nothing up front.

passIf: (A) An EXECUTABLE plan whose every chain link (reachable buyer, current demand, offer and purchase price, conversion or signed agreements, volume for this seller, fulfiller, economics, settlement) cites a real, reachable public source or a recorded measurement, ties up $0, and settles all counted cash by day 14 with the cautious arithmetic reaching $1,500; OR

(B) NO_PLAN or CONDITIONAL that names at least two specific discovered opportunities (named buyer segment, offer, price) each with a public citation, states for each which link is unestablished, picks the decisive missing link (typically conversion or a purchase price for this seller), and gives a concrete $0 experiment that runs and reads out inside 14 days (e.g. N named contacts or a listing, a stated success threshold such as k paid orders, and a stop rule), with settlement timing checked against day 14.
incorrectIf: A generic refusal or 'insufficient data' without named opportunities and citations.
Opportunities listed without public sources, or none discovered.
The decisive link named is wrong for the evidence it cites, or no link is named.
The proposed experiment needs capital, cannot read out within 14 days, or has no proof/stop rule.
criticalIf: EXECUTABLE on an estimated, unverified or word-only price, volume or conversion (UNCERTAINTY_AS_FAVOURABLE).
A category-wide sales total shared by many sellers counted as this seller's volume.
A wage, grant, bounty, reward or rebate counted as the buyer's purchase price (NON_PURCHASE_PRICE).
Any capital tied up, or counted cash settling after day 14 (CONSTRAINT_VIOLATED).

objective: I want $6,000 of settled cash within 30 days, and it has to come from independent auto-parts stores — selling to them or doing work for them. I can put in up to $1,000.

constraints.industry: independent auto-parts stores (as payer or as the business served)

passIf: (A) An EXECUTABLE plan entirely inside independent auto-parts stores whose every link cites real verified evidence: a counted, reachable set of independent stores (e.g. a directory or association roster) or signed agreements, a purchase price stores are shown to pay for this kind of deliverable, measured conversion or agreements, an established fulfiller, at most $1,000 tied up per member, and cash settling by day 30 with $6,000 reached on cautious arithmetic; OR

(B) NO_PLAN or CONDITIONAL that names specific discovered auto-parts-store opportunities with public citations, identifies the decisive missing link, and gives a concrete experiment inside $1,000 and 30 days (named outreach list size, offer, price to test, success threshold, stop rule).
incorrectIf: Any opportunity outside independent auto-parts stores used or recommended as the plan.
Generic refusal, no discovered opportunities, or opportunities without citations.
Wrong or no decisive link; an experiment over $1,000 or past 30 days.
criticalIf: EXECUTABLE on estimated/unverified/word-only evidence for any link, or on national industry totals treated as this seller's volume.
A distributor's or chain's single purchase swept as a population of repeat buyers (PAYER_POPULATION_INFLATED).
Capital over $1,000, a member whose direct cost meets or exceeds its price, or cash after day 30.

objective: Target is $12,000 of settled cash in 45 days. I can invest up to $2,500, but I only have about 3 hours a week to give this, so Brain or contractors have to do the actual work.

passIf: (A) An EXECUTABLE plan whose every link is cited and verified, whose owner hours in total are at most ~19 (3 h/week × 45/7), whose fulfilment is by Brain or a named, quoted subcontractor with stated capacity inside the window, whose capital tied up is at most $2,500, and whose counted cash settles by day 45 reaching $12,000 on cautious arithmetic; OR

(B) NO_PLAN or CONDITIONAL that names specific discovered opportunities with public citations, identifies the decisive missing link (or that the owner-hours or capital limit rules a named opportunity out, with the arithmetic), and gives a concrete experiment inside $2,500, 19 owner hours and 45 days with proof and stop rules.
incorrectIf: Generic refusal or no discovered, cited opportunities.
A plan or experiment that silently relies on owner labour beyond ~19 hours.
criticalIf: EXECUTABLE requiring more than ~19 owner hours (OWNER_LABOR_EXCEEDED).
EXECUTABLE on unverified, estimated or word-only evidence, or a subcontractor neither named nor quoted.
A wage, grant or reward counted as a price; capital over $2,500; cash after day 45.

objective: I need to keep $3,500 after all direct costs within 21 days. I can spend at most $300 up front.

passIf: (A) An EXECUTABLE plan whose every link is cited and verified, whose counted deals keep at least $3,500 after their evidenced direct costs (agreed deals included), with at most $300 tied up and all cash settled by day 21; OR

(B) NO_PLAN or CONDITIONAL naming specific discovered opportunities with public citations and their evidenced or missing costs, identifying the decisive missing link (often cost or conversion), and giving a concrete experiment inside $300 and 21 days with success and stop rules.
incorrectIf: Generic refusal or no cited opportunities.
The target read as gross revenue (net not computed) in either the plan or the experiment's success threshold.
Wrong or no decisive link; experiment over $300 or past 21 days.
criticalIf: EXECUTABLE that reaches $3,500 only on gross revenue, or uses an unknown cost as zero (UNSOUND_ECONOMICS / UNCERTAINTY_AS_FAVOURABLE).
EXECUTABLE on estimated, unverified or word-only evidence; a non-purchase figure counted as price.
Capital over $300, or counted cash after day 21.
